original.name: multiequalizerEquivAux
original.statement: MulticospanShape.{w, w'}} (I : MulticospanIndex J C) : (I.multicospan ⋙ forget C).sections ≃ { x : ∀ i : J.L, ToType (I.left i) // ∀ i : J.R, I.fst i (x _) = I.snd i (x _) } where toFun x
